items.quote: James and crew are great people to work with. I live down the street from him and he also takes care of many other yards in our neighborhood. He cuts weekly in the summer and every other week in the fall / winter months. Everytime he cuts he edges and blows. I also have him keep the shrubs trimmed up.
I was in need of an irrigation pump and the person that cuts my lawn recommended James Sneed. I called and right away James knew exactly what size pump i needed. I also asked about a wifi controller.

When our old landscape company retired, they transferred us to James and his crew at Heroic. At first we were skeptical since we didn't necessarily choose Heroic ourselves, but after James took over it was obvious we didn't have to worry.
